text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Embeddings route (emb-v2) QPS spike detected - sustained 8x baseline for 7m. 95th latency > 1.2s, error rate rising 5% (429s). Paging eng-oncall.
leah: seeing it, joining. can someone paste top customer ids?
miguel: digging — top offender is cust_42 and cust_88, both using high-concurrency batch workloads. cust_42 is hitting 500 qps sustained.
jen: impact summary from edge: ~5 external tenants saw 429s, ~12 internal test keys saw throttles. No big increases in CPU on hosts, it's queue/backpressure on serving pools.
leah: quick mitigation plan: 1) carve embeddings route down 40% global soft qps 2) carve rerank route to low priority (soft throttle) 3) keep chat routes untouched (high priority). sound ok?
miguel: ack. I'll apply per-endpoint quota tweaks now. doing staged change to avoid auth storms.
ops-bot: Running quota update (dry-run=false) 
ops-bot: PATCH /admin/routes/quotas {"route":"embeddings","scope":"global","qps_delta":-0.4,"mode":"soft"} -> queued
ops-bot: Result: applied to 80% of edge nodes (rolling). Expected convergence 30s.
leah: monitoring — can we also pin a rerank fallback? if rerank overloads, fallback to single-pass scoring.
jen: added rerank policy: priority=low, fallback=single-pass. command: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal-admin.redwood/api/v1/policies/route-fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"route":"rerank","fallback":"single-pass","priority":"low","rollout":"immediate"}'
```
miguel: rerank policy applied. throttles showing in metrics now, error rate for embeddings down to 1.8% after carve. latency improving.
sara: FYI cust_42 SRE just DM'd: they have a pipeline spike during nightly indexing, will throttle their clients. asking for temporary whitelist for some tokens.
leah: do not whitelist yet. we need global stability. ask them to reduce concurrency or use backoff. collect list of impacted customers for postmortem.
miguel: noted. I'll capture customer ids and sample request headers.
ops-bot: Metric digest (1m): emb QPS: baseline 120 -> 960 -> 580 after carve. 429s down from 5% -> 0.9%.
leah: good. set follow-up tasks: 1) postmortem, 2) recommend per-tenant burst limit and rate keys, 3) consider autoscaling policy change on embeddings pool. miguel take ownership?
miguel: taking ownership. will run follow-up.
leah: handoff — my rotation ends in 45m, miguel you'll be primary. I'll leave notes in the incident channel and escalate if anything regresses.
jen: packing notes: we should add an automated per-route soft-limit that triggers dynamic carve when queue depth > 80% for 2m. file an RFC?
sara: I'll coordinate customer comms for the two affected enterprise tenants. initial message: brief outage, mitigation applied, ETA for root cause TBD.
leah: thanks. final ask before I go: miguel, verify no chat endpoints were affected, and add a canary to ensure chat SLOs stay green.
miguel: verified chat unaffected. deploying chat canary checks now.
ops-bot: Incident severity set to Sev3. Page acknowledged by leah.
leah: leaving thread. miguel ping me if escalates. :wave:
miguel: will do. continuing monitoring. updating runbook with quota deltas and timestamps.
ops-bot: Closing note: mitigation window started at 1993330153, ended (rollback candidate) not scheduled.
leah: (after-action) we'll hold the reduced embeddings qps for 2h then evaluate autoscale and tenant limits.
jen: added follow-up ticket IR-199333 for postmortem + action items.
